TaskDescription: Resting calibration (eyes-open, eyes-closed) and brief (~17 s) isolated exposure to two soundscapes (jungle, deconstruct), always in that fixed order; segments concatenated with ~3 s margins, see events.tsv. In addition to the 14 EEG channels the file carries the manufacturer's per-channel contact-quality (CQ_*) and EEG-quality (EQ_*) indices, the two overall indices, CMS/DRL contact quality and sample-rate quality, all at 128 Hz; see channels.tsv.
